ALTER TABLE task DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_task_compose_config;
ALTER TABLE task
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_task_compose_config
    FOREIGN KEY (compose_config_id) REFERENCES compose_config(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

ALTER TABLE lesson DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_lesson_compose_config;
ALTER TABLE lesson
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_lesson_compose_config
    FOREIGN KEY (compose_config_id) REFERENCES compose_config(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
